## Activity

During March 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 259 captures. The clinic’s session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded capture activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The figures summarise activity for the month and should be read alongside the associated quality and grading measures.

## Image quality

Of the 259 captures, 13 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.0%. The image-quality result is reported against the total capture activity for March 2020. Ungradable images are identified separately so that the grading results can be considered in the context of the overall number of captures completed.

## Grading

Grading identified 52 referable results. The median grading wait was 1 day. This provides the reported measure of the time between capture and completion of grading. Together, the referable result count and the median grading wait describe the grading outcome for the month. The findings should be considered with the capture volume and the image-quality result reported above.
